(Who it’s for)

Built for brands that sell to people on their phones.

If your customers scroll Reels, Shorts or TikTok, creator content is where they already pay attention.

D2C and e-commerce

Unboxing, haul and “I tried it” videos that show the product in real hands.

Beauty and personal care

Get-ready-with-me clips, routines and honest before-and-afters.

Food and beverage

Taste tests, quick recipes and first-sip reactions.

Apps and games

Screen recordings, challenges and “you need this app” moments.

Fashion

Styling videos, outfit swaps and try-on hauls.

Local and retail launches

Store visits and new-opening content to fill a launch week.

A good fit if

  • You sell something people can show on camera
  • Your customers are on Instagram, Shorts or TikTok
  • You can fund a campaign from ₹10,000
  • You want reach and learnings, not one polished film

Probably not yet if

  • You need a single, tightly scripted brand video
  • Creators can’t get or see your product
  • You need guaranteed sales numbers
  • Your category has strict ad rules (we’ll talk it through)

(Trust and safety)

Your brand stays in your hands.

Views you can check

Payouts are based on views tracked on each post and shown in your dashboard.

Creators you approve

Creators apply to your brief. You approve who joins and set the rules on what to say and avoid.

Content rights, agreed upfront

If you want to reuse creator videos on your channels or as ads, usage terms are agreed per campaign before it starts.

A budget cap you set

Payouts stop when the budget is spent. How unused budget is handled is written into your campaign terms.

Fees shown before you pay

Your quote includes the platform fee, so nothing is added after you fund.

Off-brand content, handled

Creators follow your brief, and you can flag a post that doesn’t fit so it gets fixed or taken down.

(FAQ)

Questions before the call.

What is the minimum budget?

₹10,000. Above that you can fund as much as you want.

How do creators get paid?

They earn a set amount per 1,000 views on their approved posts, paid from your campaign budget.

What if the budget isn’t fully spent?

Payouts only happen when views do. Talk to us on the call about how unused budget is handled.

How are views counted?

Views are tracked on each creator’s post and shown in your dashboard before payouts are made.

Can I choose which creators join?

Yes. Creators apply inside our app and you approve the ones that fit your brand.

Can you guarantee a video goes viral?

No one honestly can. Many creators posting at once raises your odds, and you only pay for views that happen.

How do you deal with fake or low-quality views?

Views are tracked on each post and shown in your dashboard before payouts are made. Ask us on the call how we check for unusual activity.

Can I reuse the videos as ads?

Usage rights are agreed per campaign before it starts, so you know what you can reuse and for how long.

What if a creator posts something off-brand?

Creators work from your brief and you approve who joins. If a post doesn’t fit, flag it and we’ll get it fixed or taken down.

Is there a fee on top of my budget?

The platform fee is shown in your quote before you fund anything.
